## What happens

Asked for references, a model can return citations with real-looking authors, journals and years that do not exist. A subtler version: the paper exists, but does not contain the result attributed to it.

## How to catch it

- Resolve every reference in ADS or by DOI before using it.
- For each citation, find the sentence in the paper that supports the claim.

## How to prevent it

Give the model the papers (or their abstracts) and require it to cite only from that set, as in [Literature search with NASA ADS](../workflows/literature-ads.qmd). Then check automatically that every cited identifier is in the set.
